focused_recheck_findings.value: Only current Stanford doctoral or professional-school students may pursue the Political Science MA, in combination with their existing doctoral/professional degree; the department offers no coterm MA or external MA, and this is a dual, not joint, degree. Formal MA application is not required. Obtain home-department approval, submit the MA Course Plan, then the Graduate Authorization Petition through Axess (USD 125 petition fee). After completing requirements submit the MA Program Proposal and apply for degree conferral in Axess; award is not automatic. Degree requires 45 units, including 25 units of 300-level Political Science seminars across fields and 20 further units (up to 10 outside Political Science with DGS approval). Funding/plan should be discussed with home department; no Political Science route funding is promised.
